buildCommand: pnpm --filter @jobcopilot/shared build && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = "production" ]; then attempt=1; while [ "$attempt" -le 3 ]; do if pnpm --filter @jobcopilot/web exec prisma migrate deploy; then break; fi; if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; attempt=$((attempt + 1)); sleep 10; done; fi && pnpm --filter @jobcopilot/web exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @jobcopilot/web build
